body:
server : escape the special tokens without std::regex ( #30243 )

The d1-omni and kev prompts escape "<|name|>" in the request text with

std::regex_replace. libstdc++ recurses for each char of the name, so a

state of "<|" and 30000 letters overflows the stack of the HTTP thread

and llama-server dies with SIGSEGV.

server_decision_escape_special_tokens() writes the same text with a loop.

summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11608构建，针对llama-server中的特殊字符转义逻辑进行了重构。此前使用std::regex_replace处理长字符会导致libstdc++递归过深从而触发栈溢出（SIGSEGV），新版本改用循环逻辑修复了该服务崩溃缺陷。
